fontPolicy.risk: Installed fonts, CJK fallback, real weight faces, line breaks and glyph shapes must be inspected on the actual render machine; these stacks do not promise pixel identity.

tokenRoles.text: Essential titles/body; check actual size/weight and background.
tokenRoles.text-mute: Essential small labels; source flat-surface target >=4.5.
tokenRoles.text-faint: Nonessential low-priority annotation or large labels only; not essential small copy; source flat-surface target >=3.
tokenRoles.accent: Brand fill, nonessential line or large graphic; not assumed safe for small text.
tokenRoles.accent-strong: Small accent-colored text on surface tiers; source target >=4.5.
tokenRoles.accent-on: Text on solid accent fill only; source target >=4.5.
tokenRoles.status: Use labels/icons as well as color; colors do not validate the truth of data.
tokenRoles.chart: Always label directly or use shape/dash as well; pairwise category distinctness remains render-review-pending.

review.notes: Static values are not pixel measurements, renderer output or a visual approval.

materialRisk: No texture-based identity claim; actual material, layout and contrast still require rendered inspection.
